import html # Example template – replace with the actual one if different. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{headline}

Posted by: {poster_name}

{text}
{tags}
""" def compose_post_html( poster_name: str, headline: str, text: str, hashtags: list[str], ) -> str: """ Build an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- poster_name : str Name of the author. headline : str Post title. text : str Main body of the post. hashtags : list[str] List of tags. Each tag will be wrapped in a element. Returns ------- str The fully escaped, well‑formed HTML string. """ # Escape all user‑supplied content to neutralise XSS vectors. escaped_poster = html.escape(poster_name, quote=True) escaped_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) escaped_text = html.escape(text, quote=False) # Create tags for each hashtag, escaping the tag value. escaped_tags = " ".join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in hashtags ) # Format the template with the escaped values. return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster_name=escaped_poster, headline=escaped_headline, text=escaped_text, tags=escaped_tags )
